node.label: Z-band streaming
node.definition: Streaming or smearing of the Z band, which is then no longer confined to a narrow zone which bisects the I band. The Z disk may extend across the I band or the entire sarcomere in a zigzag manner. Focal thickening, smudging, and blurring of the Z band takes place concurrently. Myofibrillar disorganization is a frequent but not invariable accompanying change.

evidence.snippet: Myopathy, myofibrillar, 13, with rimmed vacuoles: Z-band streaming (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
